business_summary: Sportsoul Co.,Ltd. engages in research, development, design, production, and sale of recreational sports and fitness equipment in China and internationally. The company offers trampoline; home gym toning, weight bench, utility bench, flat blench, full power rack, and box standing; multi-sport training rebounder, soccer goal with practice banners, and portable basketball hoop; and treadmills, ellipticals, exercise bikes, integrated training machines, and barbell rack. It sells its products under the Skywalker, SPORTSOUL, and Techplus brands. Sportsoul Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Qingdao, China.
